blocks.content: In this recap, you'll explore the following questions about the company's employees:

items: Which employees have the highest salaries, listed in descending order?
What is the salary range (highest and lowest) in each department?
How many employees are there in each department?
Which departments have fewer than two employees?
Which employees' names contain the letter "J"?
Which employees are eligible for promotion based on their years of service?

blocks.content: Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
